The '''Glittering Mynock''' was a relative of the common [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]. Similar in look to its cousin, the Glittering Mynock had the exact same trait of sucking on power sources until they were drained. The Glittering Mynock, however, would give off a rainbow of colored lights from its wings while feeding.
